name: mariettaviolinwithcarla-com
description: Static studio and lesson-request site for Marietta Violin with Carla
author: Jacob Anderson

scripts.build: npm run validate:content && npm run verify:analytics && npm run verify:retired-secrets && npm run -w front-end build
scripts.dev: npm run validate:content && npm run -w front-end dev
scripts.postinstall: python3 -B scripts/check-unimport-source.py && node scripts/check-build-toolchain.mjs && node scripts/check-toolchain-package.mjs && node scripts/patch-minimatch-consumers.mjs && simple-git-hooks && npm run -w front-end prepare
scripts.test: npm run validate:content && npm run verify:analytics && npm run verify:retired-secrets && npm run -w front-end test:unit && node --test test/*.test.mjs vendor/tests/*.test.mjs && npm run test:artifact && npm run test:build-toolchain && npm run test:toolchain-package && node --test scripts/test-devtools-provider.mjs scripts/test-vue-devtools-compat.mjs && npm run test:devtools && npm run test:unimport-source && node --test scripts/test-npm-tool-majors.mjs && npm run verify:shared-build && npm run test:shared-build && npm run test:local-libraries
scripts.lint: npm run lint:root && npm run -w front-end lint
scripts.lint-fix: npm run lint:root -- --fix && npm run -w front-end lint-fix
scripts.audit: npm run audit:toolchain && npm audit --audit-level=low && npm run audit:unimport-source && npm run audit:shared-build
scripts.audit:production: npm run audit:toolchain -- --omit=dev && npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=low && npm run audit:unimport-source && npm run audit:shared-build
scripts.audit:signatures: npm audit signatures && npm run check:unimport-source
scripts.test:unimport-source: node --test --test-concurrency=1 scripts/test-unimport-source.mjs && node scripts/test-unimport-artifact.mjs && python3 -B -m unittest discover -s scripts -p test_unimport_source.py -v
scripts.audit:unimport-source: npm audit --prefix vendor/unimport/build --workspaces=false --audit-level=low && npm audit --prefix vendor/unimport/build --workspaces=false --omit=dev --audit-level=low && npm audit signatures --prefix vendor/unimport/build && npm audit --prefix vendor/unimport/runtime --workspaces=false --audit-level=low && npm audit --prefix vendor/unimport/runtime --workspaces=false --omit=dev --audit-level=low && npm audit signatures --prefix vendor/unimport/runtime
scripts.verify:shared-build: npm run verify:local-libraries && python3 -B scripts/package-native-providers.py --check && python3 -B scripts/package-framework-parents.py --check && python3 -B scripts/package-schema-parents.py --check && python3 -B scripts/package-vue-devtools.py --check && python3 -B scripts/package-unhead-compat.py --check && python3 -B scripts/package-rollup-compat.py --check && python3 -B scripts/check-nitro-tool-inputs.py && python3 -B scripts/package-unwasm-compat.py --check && python3 -B scripts/package-jiti-compat.py --check
scripts.test:shared-build: python3 -B -m unittest discover -s scripts -p test_native_providers.py -v && node --test scripts/test-native-providers.mjs scripts/test-native-provider-types.mjs && python3 -B -m unittest discover -s scripts -p test_framework_parents.py -v && node --test scripts/test-framework-parents.mjs scripts/test-framework-parent-types.mjs && python3 -B -m unittest discover -s scripts -p test_schema_parents.py -v && node --test scripts/test-schema-parents.mjs scripts/test-schema-parent-types.mjs && python3 -B -m unittest discover -s scripts -p test_vue_devtools.py -v && node --test scripts/test-vue-devtools-types.mjs scripts/test-shared-build-contract.mjs && python3 -B -m unittest discover -s scripts -p test_unhead_compat.py -v && python3 -B -m unittest discover -s scripts -p test_rollup_compat.py -v && node --test scripts/test-rollup-compat.mjs && python3 -B -m unittest discover -s scripts -p test_nitro_tool_inputs.py -v && python3 -B -m unittest discover -s scripts -p test_unwasm_compat.py -v && node --test --test-concurrency=2 scripts/test-nitro-tools.mjs scripts/test-nitro-runtime.mjs && python3 -B -m unittest discover -s scripts -p test_reference_local_inputs.py -v && python3 -B -m unittest discover -s scripts -p test_jiti_compat.py -v && node --test scripts/test-jiti-compat.mjs
scripts.test:shared-build-browser: node scripts/test-native-providers-host.mjs && node scripts/test-framework-parents-browser.mjs && node scripts/test-rollup-browser.mjs && node scripts/test-nitro-tools-browser.mjs
scripts.test:local-libraries: python3 -B -m unittest discover -s scripts -p test_local_libraries.py -v && node --test scripts/test-local-library-install.mjs

simple-git-hooks.pre-commit: test -x ./node_modules/.bin/lint-staged || { echo 'lint-staged is not installed. Run npm install.'; exit 1; }; ./node_modules/.bin/lint-staged
